about.title: A clean Atyrau, together
about.lead: Taza AI is a civic eco-platform for Atyrau. Saw a dump, smoke or an oil stain? Take a photo. The AI helps describe the problem and drafts an official appeal for eOtinish, and residents together follow it until it is fixed.
about.step1: Photograph the problem and mark the place on the map.
about.step2: The AI suggests a title, category and severity — you check and edit.
about.step3: A ready text in Russian or Kazakh — you submit it yourself on eOtinish.kz via eGov.
about.basedOn: Taza AI is built on the open-source project {{name}} by {{author}} (MIT license). The map, feed and reports API come from it; AI, environmental data and appeals are added on top.
about.ethics: The AI never concludes that a law was broken or that a specific company is to blame. All AI estimates are preliminary and may be wrong.
about.step4: A report closes when three residents confirm with an “after” photo.

air.title: Air
air.text: Air quality and wind now and for 48 hours, a personal AI plan for walks and sport.

fires.title: Satellite
fires.text: NASA FIRMS thermal anomalies in the oblast for the week, with an AI digest.

about.privacy: Only the photo and the problem description go to the AI (Google Gemini, free tier) — no names, contacts or coordinates. You submit the appeal yourself: we send nothing on your behalf.
about.demo: Demo reports are fictional. Their photographs illustrate similar situations in other places.
